dog.description_text:
Watson

Watson deserves a home where he has companionship, love and someone—or maybe another dog—to keep him company.

🐾 About 1–2 years old
🐾 12 lbs. of adorable
🏡 House trained
🦴 Crate trained
🐶 Good with other dogs
👧 Good with children
❤️ Great with adults
🐕 Would especially love a home with another dog for companionship

Watson really is a GREAT little dog. He isn't being returned because he did something wrong. Life simply changed around him.
dog.name: Watson
